rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read-only National Hockey League data fetched on demand from the NHL's public, keyless web and stats APIs. Current tables give today's standings, this week's schedule, today's scores, and skater and goalie leaders. Parameterized functions cover standings on any date since 1917-18, schedules and scores by date, team seasons, season skater/goalie/team reports, leaderboards, rosters, player profiles, career lines, game logs, name search, box scores, play-by-play with rink coordinates, shift charts, playoff brackets, drafts, teams, and franchises. Seasons are 8-digit ids such as 20252026; game_type is 2 regular season, 3 playoffs, 1 preseason; game ids are 10 digits such as 2025020001.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# NHL standings, games, and statistics

Query current and historical National Hockey League data directly from SQL: standings, schedules and scores, season reports for every skater, goalie, and team, official leaderboards, rosters and player careers, and per-game box scores, play-by-play, and shift charts.

## Identifiers

Seasons are 8-digit ids (`20252026` is 2025-26). `game_type` is 2 for the regular season, 3 for the playoffs, and 1 for the preseason. Game ids are 10 digits (`2025020001`) and player ids 7 digits (`8478402`); `player_search()` finds them.

## Source

All access is read-only, keyless, and on demand from NHL.com's own backends; nothing is stored or rehosted. This project is not affiliated with the NHL.
rows.vgi.executable_examples: [{"name": "opener_final_score", "description": "The 2025-26 opener (game 2025020001) ended Florida 3, Chicago 2.", "sql": "SELECT home_team_abbrev, home_score, away_team_abbrev, away_score FROM nhl.main.scores(date := DATE '2025-10-07') WHERE game_id = 2025020001", "expected_result": [{"home_team_abbrev": "FLA", "home_score": 3, "away_team_abbrev": "CHI", "away_score": 2}]}, {"name": "opener_goal_events", "description": "The opener's play-by-play contains its five goals.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) AS goals FROM nhl.main.play_by_play(2025020001) WHERE event_type = 'goal'", "expected_result": [{"goals": 5}]}, {"name": "current_standings_have_teams", "description": "Today's standings list every NHL team with a team code.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) >= 32 AND count(team_abbrev) = count(*) AS populated FROM nhl.main.current_standings", "expected_result": [{"populated": true}]}]
